title: MED+250 production security and catalogue contract deployment
summary: A fresh privileged verification detected direct product-image governance drift despite an unchanged contract version. Forward migration 20260716190000 restored the verified-rights constraint, RLS policy, service publisher, runtime trigger, and DDL guard; unverified images were removed from catalogue and Storage exposure, and unsafe detached workers were stopped.

checks.name: Migration ledger alignment
checks.detail: All 61 production-authorised local MED+250 migrations are present in the production ledger with matching versions and names. Repair migration 20260716190000 is recorded as reassert_verified_product_image_governance. Earlier quarantined effects remain historical only and are superseded by later governed migrations.

checks.name: Publication audit enforcement
checks.detail: Production now rejects approved or rejected catalogue states that lack a matching immutable audit event for that row version.

checks.name: Verified product-image publication boundary
checks.detail: All 72 rights-unverified image rows are retained only as non-approved provenance records; zero catalogue links point to them. The incident remediation removed 30 unverified or orphaned public Storage objects without emitting identifiers, and a delayed final check found the bucket empty. A validated constraint, verified-only RLS policy, service publication RPC, independent approval trigger, and DDL event guard enforce the boundary.

checks.name: Governance DDL rejection
checks.detail: A production attempt to drop the verified-rights constraint without the reviewed transaction-local repair override was rejected with SQLSTATE 42501. A post-rejection query confirmed the constraint, RLS policy, runtime trigger, DDL guard, and zero-unsafe-row state remained intact.

checks.name: Quarantined pharmacy candidate remediation
checks.detail: The 25 browser-observation phone candidates from the quarantined import were removed from the production contact table. Zero candidate login or WhatsApp contacts remain, while authoritative source-verified contact rows were preserved.

checks.name: Deployment contract refresh
checks.detail: The production backend contract was refreshed to version 2026-07-16.10 and requires explicit reuse-rights verification in the schema constraint, publication RPC, public RLS policy, independent runtime approval trigger, and DDL governance guard.

checks.name: Unsafe worker containment
checks.detail: Two detached image-worker process groups using a rejected loop script were stopped. The rejected script and migration were removed from executable paths, the Python publisher again verifies the full rights-governance contract before every upload and publication call, and unverified galleries are retained for review without upload.
